name: smwpatches-piranha-plant-patch-fix
title: Piranha Plant Patch Fix
description:
This is both of the two Classic Piranha Plant fix patches made by BMF54123.

This patch fixes an error where the Classic Piranha Plant would sometimes overwrite the tile properties of a different sprite, and it fixes its stem using a fish tile.
It also includes information incase you want the Piranhas to be global (at the expense of the Flopping Fish tile in SP2).

I fixed it up with a RATS tag.
More importantly though, it is now more compatible with other patches.

Previously was the 200th submitted patch!
